name: uniform_random
formula: Uniform sample 6 without replacement from 1..45; target/mode seed=first 8 bytes big-endian SHA256(null_seed|target|mode); first generated ticket.
variables: No learned variables; equal inclusion probability.
baseline: exact uniform hypergeometric; frozen negative controls

name: long_frequency
formula: score(x)=F_x, number of training draws containing x; top six.
selection_rule: top six score with lower-number ties
candidate_rule: top six plus all 6 x 6 substitutions using rank positions 7..12; score by sum; 37 unique
baseline: exact uniform hypergeometric; frozen negative controls

name: corrected_next_draw_gap_hazard
variables: Age measured after previous draw; bins 0,1,2,3..5,6..10,11+. For each observed training transition, pooled R increments for numbers already observed in that window, H increments if next training draw contains x; unseen numbers assigned age=n. Includes ongoing exposures; no completed-interval shift.
parameters_weights: Beta prior strength=20; pooled across 45 numbers; top six
selection_rule: top six score with lower-number ties
candidate_rule: top six plus all 6 x 6 substitutions using rank positions 7..12; score by sum; 37 unique
baseline: exact uniform hypergeometric; frozen negative controls

name: conditional_count10
variables: For each training next draw with >=10 prior draws, pooled state c in 0..10 and next membership counts.
selection_rule: top six score with lower-number ties
candidate_rule: top six plus all 6 x 6 substitutions using rank positions 7..12; score by sum; 37 unique
baseline: exact uniform hypergeometric; frozen negative controls

name: hot_cold_transition
variables: a=count(x,prior20)>20*(6/45), b=count(x,recent20)>20*(6/45); train forward transitions with >=40 prior draws.
selection_rule: top six score with lower-number ties
candidate_rule: top six plus all 6 x 6 substitutions using rank positions 7..12; score by sum; 37 unique
baseline: exact uniform hypergeometric; frozen negative controls

name: pair_residual_node
variables: O_ab=training pair count. Shares frequency inputs with other models; not independent evidence.
selection_rule: top six score with lower-number ties
candidate_rule: top six plus all 6 x 6 substitutions using rank positions 7..12; score by sum; 37 unique
baseline: exact uniform hypergeometric; frozen negative controls

name: triple_residual_node
formula: E_abc=(20/36)*(2025/1892)*F_a*F_b*F_c/n^2; z=(O-E)/sqrt(max(E,1e-12)); score(x)=sum triples containing x of z.
variables: O_abc=training triple count. Shares pair/frequency history; prior weak windows retained.
selection_rule: top six score with lower-number ties
candidate_rule: top six plus all 6 x 6 substitutions using rank positions 7..12; score by sum; 37 unique
baseline: exact uniform hypergeometric; frozen negative controls

name: fixed_support_structure_transition
variables: Training transitions start with third window draw so previous overlap is defined. Profile: odd, low<=22, floor(sum/30), five bands, consecutive count, repeated-ending excess, previous-draw overlap, clusters=1+#gaps>5.
parameters_weights: Laplace alpha=1; eight feature weights=1; fixed K in RULES_V4.json; highest among fixed 10000-bank
baseline: exact uniform hypergeometric; frozen negative controls
